title: Martinet at Môtiers-Travers: ciphered message on the Neuchâtel officers affair, only partly deciphered
correspondents: Martinet (Môtiers, Val-de-Travers) → Prussian administration of Neuchâtel / Berlin
shelfmark: GStA PK, I. HA Rep. 64 (Oranische Erbschaft / Neuchâtel), Nr. 828
folio_note: one message in a file of 1758-1759; length not given

prior_art.decode: DECODE keyword search (de-crypt.org RecordsList, 11 Nov 2026) for "Martinet", "Travers", "Neuchâtel", "Neuchatel": no matching record; DECODE lists no GStA PK holdings at all (searches "GStA", "Geheimes", "Dahlem", "Privy State" gave only Dresden and BL rows). The only Neuchâtel hit is a picture postcard (record 3490).
prior_art.tomokiyo: Cryptiana german.htm and frederick.htm fetched 11 Nov 2026 and searched for Neuch, Martinet, Metternich, Dupuy: not mentioned.
prior_art.lasry: No Lasry paper on Prussian Neuchâtel ciphers turned up in the two web searches below; his own list was not opened.
prior_art.edition: No edition of the Neuchâtel administrative files of 1758-59 found. Bourgeois, Neuchâtel et la politique prussienne en Franche-Comté (1887, archive.org full text opened) stops at 1713. The Politische Correspondenz prints Frederick's own letters, not incoming notes of local informants; its 1758-59 volumes were not opened.
prior_art.literature: Web searches on Martinet, Môtiers, 1758 and the Vattel/Pury/Perregaux affair returned only HLS biographies and Rousseau material, nothing on this message or its cipher.

vetting.key_check: No key held in the repo. The archive files a Neuchâtel "dictionnaire chiffré" of 1703 in Rep. 64 Nr. 944 and cipher notes in Nr. 777 and 962; none could be tried because nothing is online.
vetting.key_held: GStA PK I. HA Rep. 64 Nr. 944 (cipher table sent 8 Nov 1703) and Nr. 777 ("Handhabung der Chiffrierung", 1742-48); not tested, not online.
vetting.duplicates: known.py "Rep. 64", "Martinet", "Môtiers", "Montmollin": no hits in catalogue, leads, targets or sweeps.

title: Prussian succession at Neuchâtel: partly ciphered reports of the agents, files with no decipherment noted
correspondents: Marc Dupuy (Bern), brothers Bondeli, Jean-Scipion de Peyrol, Emer de Montmollin, Ernst von Metternich, F. W. Duncker → Frederick I / Wartenberg
folio_note: eleven files; "Berichterstattungen (teils chiffriert)"; amount of cipher not given
status: GStA finding aid says "teils chiffriert" for these files and, for the sibling files Nr. 695-706, "teils chiffriert mit Entzifferung"; Nr. 995 has "chiffrierte Briefe mit Dechiffrierung zwischen den Zeilen" (Jul-Sep 1706) beside reports of Mar-Apr 1707 "teils chiffriert". Whether the files without the note really lack a decipherment is not known. Key table of 1703 in Nr. 944.
why: The secret side of the Prussian acquisition of Neuchâtel in the War of the Spanish Succession.
score_note: Scored from the archive description during the 11 Nov 2026 German sweep (research/sweep_2026-11-11_german/); not viewed
verify: Order sample scans of Nr. 692 and 717; the interlined siblings (Nr. 695-706, 995) and the table in Nr. 944 should read any piece left in cipher. No vetting block: needs the files.
